texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: RULES FOR THE TRADING GAME
texts.text: RULES FOR THE TRADING GAME

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trade management demands simple understanding of complex market forces. Use these battletested rules to internalize the classic mechanics that move price and create opportunity.
texts.text: Trade management demands simple understanding of complex market forces. Use these battletested rules to internalize the classic mechanics that move price and create opportunity.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: MARKET WISDOM
texts.text: MARKET WISDOM

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Forget the news, remember the numbers.
texts.text: Forget the news, remember the numbers.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You're not smart enough to know how news will affect price. The chart already knows and reflects it in the numbers. Use the period before scheduled news to apply a convergence-divergence analysis that compares price action to current expectations. The best information comes when the chart diverges sharply from common wisdom.
texts.text: You're not smart enough to know how news will affect price. The chart already knows and reflects it in the numbers. Use the period before scheduled news to apply a convergence-divergence analysis that compares price action to current expectations. The best information comes when the chart diverges sharply from common wisdom.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · If you have to look, it isn't there.
texts.text: If you have to look, it isn't there.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Forget your college degree and trust your instincts. The best setups jump out from the market noise and create a sense of urgency to trade. Take a deep breath and cross-verify your numbers. Then act quickly before the opportunity disappears.
texts.text: Forget your college degree and trust your instincts. The best setups jump out from the market noise and create a sense of urgency to trade. Take a deep breath and cross-verify your numbers. Then act quickly before the opportunity disappears.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Price has memory.
texts.text: Price has memory.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: What did price do the last time it hit a certain level? Chances are it will do it again.  Trend mirrors capture some of this movement, but actual experience does a better job. Watch when a favorite stock returns to a price level that turned a profit or loss in the past. The prior tape action embeds deeply in the trading subconscious and guides fresh tactics.
texts.text: What did price do the last time it hit a certain level? Chances are it will do it again.  Trend mirrors capture some of this movement, but actual experience does a better job. Watch when a favorite stock returns to a price level that turned a profit or loss in the past. The prior tape action embeds deeply in the trading subconscious and guides fresh tactics.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Profit and discomfort stand side by side.
texts.text: Profit and discomfort stand side by side.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Look for the setup that scares you the most. That's the one you probably need to trade. Don't expect to feel comfortable until an active position finally closes out. If it feels too good, everyone else will trade it the same way and become the crowd.
texts.text: Look for the setup that scares you the most. That's the one you probably need to trade. Don't expect to feel comfortable until an active position finally closes out. If it feels too good, everyone else will trade it the same way and become the crowd.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Stand apart from the crowd at all times
texts.text: Stand apart from the crowd at all times

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trade ahead of, behind, or contrary to the crowd. Be the first in and out of the profit door. Take their money before they take yours. Always be ready to pounce on the crowd's ill-advised decisions, poor judgment, and bad timing. Your success depends on the misfortune of others.
texts.text: Trade ahead of, behind, or contrary to the crowd. Be the first in and out of the profit door. Take their money before they take yours. Always be ready to pounce on the crowd's ill-advised decisions, poor judgment, and bad timing. Your success depends on the misfortune of others.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: THE SWING
texts.text: THE SWING

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Buy the second low. Sell the second high.
texts.text: Buy the second low. Sell the second high.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Price extremes attract contrary tactics. The first test of a new high should fail. The first test of a new low should succeed. Watch for a breakout or breakdown the next time around.
texts.text: Price extremes attract contrary tactics. The first test of a new high should fail. The first test of a new low should succeed. Watch for a breakout or breakdown the next time around.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Buy the first pullback from a new high. Sell the first pullback from a new low.
texts.text: Buy the first pullback from a new high. Sell the first pullback from a new low.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Act quickly when the market gods offer a gift. Pullbacks let traders jump on board moving trains. They also provide fuel to carry a market higher or lower.
texts.text: Act quickly when the market gods offer a gift. Pullbacks let traders jump on board moving trains. They also provide fuel to carry a market higher or lower.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Buy at support.  Sell at resistance.
texts.text: Buy at support.  Sell at resistance.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: What do you do when you walk into a wall? Price has only two choices when it reaches a barrier: continue forward or reverse. Pick the right one and start counting your profits.
texts.text: What do you do when you walk into a wall? Price has only two choices when it reaches a barrier: continue forward or reverse. Pick the right one and start counting your profits.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Short rallies, not selloffs.
texts.text: Short rallies, not selloffs.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When markets drop, short sellers get ready to cover, making this a terrible time to execute new short sales. Wait until they ignite a squeeze and get shaken out at higher prices. Then jump in quietly while no one is watching.
texts.text: When markets drop, short sellers get ready to cover, making this a terrible time to execute new short sales. Wait until they ignite a squeeze and get shaken out at higher prices. Then jump in quietly while no one is watching.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: TIME
texts.text: TIME

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Trends depend on their time frame.
texts.text: Trends depend on their time frame.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trend relativity errors end trading careers. Make sure your pattern works in the period that you want to trade. Opportunity aligns to specific time segments. Profitable trades find the right ones, while losing trades chase the wrong ones.
texts.text: Trend relativity errors end trading careers. Make sure your pattern works in the period that you want to trade. Opportunity aligns to specific time segments. Profitable trades find the right ones, while losing trades chase the wrong ones.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Manage time as efficiently as price.
texts.text: Manage time as efficiently as price.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Time is money in the markets. Don't waste either. Profit relates directly to the amount of time set aside for market analysis. Know your holding period for every trade. And watch the clock to become a market survivor.
texts.text: Time is money in the markets. Don't waste either. Profit relates directly to the amount of time set aside for market analysis. Know your holding period for every trade. And watch the clock to become a market survivor.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Avoid the open.
texts.text: Avoid the open.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: They see you coming. The best opening strategies exit old trades and wait patiently for new ones.
texts.text: They see you coming. The best opening strategies exit old trades and wait patiently for new ones.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The trend is your friend.
texts.text: The trend is your friend.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Strong stocks get stronger and weak stocks get weaker. Always surf the wave in trending markets. Save contrary thinking for pullbacks and ranges.
texts.text: Strong stocks get stronger and weak stocks get weaker. Always surf the wave in trending markets. Save contrary thinking for pullbacks and ranges.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: EXECUTION
texts.text: EXECUTION

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Expect the market to reverse as soon as you get filled.
texts.text: Expect the market to reverse as soon as you get filled.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Locate the safety net before jumping into a trade. Stand aside when the exit door is out of reach. Wait for a pullback or drop down and trade the next-lower time frame. Never toss a coin into the fountain and hope your dreams will come true.
texts.text: Locate the safety net before jumping into a trade. Stand aside when the exit door is out of reach. Wait for a pullback or drop down and trade the next-lower time frame. Never toss a coin into the fountain and hope your dreams will come true.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Match tactics to market conditions.
texts.text: Match tactics to market conditions.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Shift gears quickly when trades stop working.  Market inefficiency dries up as the crowd plays your game. But a new door will open as soon as the old one closes. Find it and profit until the herd heads your way.
texts.text: Shift gears quickly when trades stop working.  Market inefficiency dries up as the crowd plays your game. But a new door will open as soon as the old one closes. Find it and profit until the herd heads your way.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trade with the TICK, not against it.
texts.text: Trade with the TICK, not against it.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Go with the money flow. Draw trendlines and channels around TICK to predict where the next big move will occur. Then trade with the wind to your back.
texts.text: Go with the money flow. Draw trendlines and channels around TICK to predict where the next big move will occur. Then trade with the wind to your back.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Major convergence signals the best trades.
texts.text: Major convergence signals the best trades.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Watch for the bull's eye. Look for the price and time that points repeatedly to a specific trade entry. The market is trying to tell you something.
texts.text: Watch for the bull's eye. Look for the price and time that points repeatedly to a specific trade entry. The market is trying to tell you something.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Don't confuse execution with opportunity.
texts.text: Don't confuse execution with opportunity.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Save Donkey Kong for the weekend. Pretty colors and fast fingers don't build successful careers. Understanding price behavior and market mechanics does. Learn what a good trade looks like before falling in love with the software.
texts.text: Save Donkey Kong for the weekend. Pretty colors and fast fingers don't build successful careers. Understanding price behavior and market mechanics does. Learn what a good trade looks like before falling in love with the software.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: OPPORTUNITY AND RISK
texts.text: OPPORTUNITY AND RISK

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The perfect opportunity rarely exists.
texts.text: The perfect opportunity rarely exists.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Learn to trade in shades of gray. Profits depend on different levels of inefficiency. Get off the sidelines and act when enough ducks sit in a row.
texts.text: Learn to trade in shades of gray. Profits depend on different levels of inefficiency. Get off the sidelines and act when enough ducks sit in a row.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Know the price that violates the pattern.
texts.text: Know the price that violates the pattern.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Keep both risk and reward in sight at all times. Look for trades where price must move only a short distance to show that it was a mistake. Then look the other way to find a profit target and apply this math to every opportunity. Limit execution to positions with low risk and high profit potential. Then update analysis with every new tick.
texts.text: Keep both risk and reward in sight at all times. Look for trades where price must move only a short distance to show that it was a mistake. Then look the other way to find a profit target and apply this math to every opportunity. Limit execution to positions with low risk and high profit potential. Then update analysis with every new tick.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Control risk before seeking reward.
texts.text: Control risk before seeking reward.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Wear your market chastity belt at all times. Attention to profit is a sign of trading immaturity, while attention to loss is a sign of trading experience. The markets have no intention of giving money to those who do not earn it.
texts.text: Wear your market chastity belt at all times. Attention to profit is a sign of trading immaturity, while attention to loss is a sign of trading experience. The markets have no intention of giving money to those who do not earn it.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Swing for percentage and distance.
texts.text: Swing for percentage and distance.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Learn to hit both the single and home run. The best profits go to the swing trader with the highest AvgWIN and %WIN. Concentrate on building both sides of the market equation.
texts.text: Learn to hit both the single and home run. The best profits go to the swing trader with the highest AvgWIN and %WIN. Concentrate on building both sides of the market equation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Big losses rarely come without warning.
texts.text: Big losses rarely come without warning.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You have no one to blame but yourself. The chart told you leave and the news told you to leave. Learn to visualize trouble and head for safety with only a few bars of uncomfortable information.
texts.text: You have no one to blame but yourself. The chart told you leave and the news told you to leave. Learn to visualize trouble and head for safety with only a few bars of uncomfortable information.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: SECRETS OF THE PRICE CHART
texts.text: SECRETS OF THE PRICE CHART

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Bulls live above the 200-day, bears live below.
texts.text: Bulls live above the 200-day, bears live below.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Are you flying with the birds or swimming with the fishes? The 200-day moving average divides the investing world in two. Bulls and greed live above the 200-day, while bears and fear live below. Sellers eat up rallies below this line, while buyers to come to the rescue above it.
texts.text: Are you flying with the birds or swimming with the fishes? The 200-day moving average divides the investing world in two. Bulls and greed live above the 200-day, while bears and fear live below. Sellers eat up rallies below this line, while buyers to come to the rescue above it.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The big move hides just beyond price congestion.
texts.text: The big move hides just beyond price congestion.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Enter in mild times and exit in wild times.  Don't count on the agitated crowd for your trading signals. It's usually too late for an easy profit by the time they act. Execute new trades in narrow bars at support or resistance whenever possible.
texts.text: Enter in mild times and exit in wild times.  Don't count on the agitated crowd for your trading signals. It's usually too late for an easy profit by the time they act. Execute new trades in narrow bars at support or resistance whenever possible.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Big volume kills trends.
texts.text: Big volume kills trends.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Blow-offs take buyers and sellers out of the market. When volume peaks too sharply or quickly, it will short circuit movement in the prevailing direction. These climax events wash out the crowd as efficiently as a flat market.
texts.text: Blow-offs take buyers and sellers out of the market. When volume peaks too sharply or quickly, it will short circuit movement in the prevailing direction. These climax events wash out the crowd as efficiently as a flat market.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Current price is the best indicator of future price.
texts.text: Current price is the best indicator of future price.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: What does the latest number say about the market? The answer predicts the next number, up or down. But go ahead and add a few indicators anyway just to stay out of trouble.
texts.text: What does the latest number say about the market? The answer predicts the next number, up or down. But go ahead and add a few indicators anyway just to stay out of trouble.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Perfect patterns carry the greatest risk for failure.
texts.text: Perfect patterns carry the greatest risk for failure.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Demand warts and bruises on your trade setups. Market mechanics work to defeat the majority when everyone sees the same thing at the same time. Look closely for failure when perfection appears.
texts.text: Demand warts and bruises on your trade setups. Market mechanics work to defeat the majority when everyone sees the same thing at the same time. Look closely for failure when perfection appears.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Trends rarely turn on a dime.
texts.text: Trends rarely turn on a dime.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Reversals build slowly. Investors are as stubborn as mules and take a lot of pain before they admit defeat. Short sellers are true disbelievers and won't cover without a fight.
texts.text: Reversals build slowly. Investors are as stubborn as mules and take a lot of pain before they admit defeat. Short sellers are true disbelievers and won't cover without a fight.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Some gaps never fill.
texts.text: Some gaps never fill.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The old traders' wisdom is a lie. Exhaustion gaps get filled. Breakaway and continuation gaps may never fill. Trade in the direction of their support when price approaches for the first time.
texts.text: The old traders' wisdom is a lie. Exhaustion gaps get filled. Breakaway and continuation gaps may never fill. Trade in the direction of their support when price approaches for the first time.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: THE MASTER SWING TRADER
texts.text: THE MASTER SWING TRADER

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Commit yourself to a lifetime of opportunity and conflict. Professional traders still face unexpected drawdowns and missed profits, but they understand that longevity depends on shaking off their short-term demons and moving on to the next trade.  And they have the confidence to expect a profit on the very next position.
texts.text: Commit yourself to a lifetime of opportunity and conflict. Professional traders still face unexpected drawdowns and missed profits, but they understand that longevity depends on shaking off their short-term demons and moving on to the next trade.  And they have the confidence to expect a profit on the very next position.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Seek market knowledge but avoid the knowledge game. Books and seminars can undermine successful trade execution after a few years of experience. Realize that secondary reinforcement from sitting at the guru's feet may not build either profits or skills. True market wisdom comes only through personal trading experience.
texts.text: Seek market knowledge but avoid the knowledge game. Books and seminars can undermine successful trade execution after a few years of experience. Realize that secondary reinforcement from sitting at the guru's feet may not build either profits or skills. True market wisdom comes only through personal trading experience.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Size doesn't matter. Avoid the bias that position size and professional responsibility must grow with trading experience. Some may find a home managing other people's assets. Others should just stay at home and watch the kids while the markets pay their lunch money. No single characteristic describes the successful swing trader. This master technician may look like a local businessman, soccer mom, or software geek.
texts.text: Size doesn't matter. Avoid the bias that position size and professional responsibility must grow with trading experience. Some may find a home managing other people's assets. Others should just stay at home and watch the kids while the markets pay their lunch money. No single characteristic describes the successful swing trader. This master technician may look like a local businessman, soccer mom, or software geek.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Treat this noble profession with great respect. Combine the discipline of a saint with the tenacity of a bulldog through every trading opportunity. The markets work to fool the majority at every turn. Don't be surprised when you suddenly become part of the crowd that you're trying to avoid. Use the opportunity to peek in the mirror and see what it looks like before extricating yourself from this dangerous herd.
texts.text: Treat this noble profession with great respect. Combine the discipline of a saint with the tenacity of a bulldog through every trading opportunity. The markets work to fool the majority at every turn. Don't be surprised when you suddenly become part of the crowd that you're trying to avoid. Use the opportunity to peek in the mirror and see what it looks like before extricating yourself from this dangerous herd.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Enjoy the long road to market knowledge. Each twist offers a new gem to carry into the next active position. Over time, many battle scars teach a profound understanding of the modern financial markets. Neophytes become members of an exclusive club as they evolve into seasoned professionals. As their power grows, they often wonder if they can fully tame the beast and have it under their total control. Unfortunately, this popular fantasy will never come true.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Even the master swing trader must take what the market gives with humility, acceptance, and good humor.

texts.orig: APPENDIX B GLOSSARY
texts.text: APPENDIX B GLOSSARY

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Abandoned baby A three-bar candlestick reversal pattern.  A single bar gaps up or down but then immediately gaps back in the opposite direction on the next bar. The shadow of the lone candle never crosses the shadow of the bar before the first gap or after the second gap.
texts.text: Abandoned baby A three-bar candlestick reversal pattern.  A single bar gaps up or down but then immediately gaps back in the opposite direction on the next bar. The shadow of the lone candle never crosses the shadow of the bar before the first gap or after the second gap.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Accumulation-distribution (acc-dis) The underlying buying or selling pressure within a particular stock.
texts.text: Accumulation-distribution (acc-dis) The underlying buying or selling pressure within a particular stock.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Adam and Eve (A&E) Top or bottom reversal pattern noted by its sharp, volatile first high (low) and slower, rounded second high (low).
texts.text: Adam and Eve (A&E) Top or bottom reversal pattern noted by its sharp, volatile first high (low) and slower, rounded second high (low).

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Ascending triangle A common continuation pattern that forms from a rising lower trendline and a horizontal top resistance line.
texts.text: Ascending triangle A common continuation pattern that forms from a rising lower trendline and a horizontal top resistance line.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: AvgLOSS A performance measurement that shows the total losses divided by the number of losing trades.
texts.text: AvgLOSS A performance measurement that shows the total losses divided by the number of losing trades.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: AvgWIN A performance measurement that shows the total profits divided by the number of winning trades.
texts.text: AvgWIN A performance measurement that shows the total profits divided by the number of winning trades.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Axe The market maker who exerts the most influence in a particular stock.
texts.text: Axe The market maker who exerts the most influence in a particular stock.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Bear hug A trading strategy that finds short sale opportunities in weak markets that rally into resistance or narrow range bars on the verge of breakdown.
texts.text: Bear hug A trading strategy that finds short sale opportunities in weak markets that rally into resistance or narrow range bars on the verge of breakdown.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Bollinger Bands (BB) Elastic support and resistance channels above and below price bars that respond to the tendency of price to draw back to center after strong movement in either direction. The Bollinger Band center band sets up at the moving average chosen for the indicator.
texts.text: Bollinger Bands (BB) Elastic support and resistance channels above and below price bars that respond to the tendency of price to draw back to center after strong movement in either direction. The Bollinger Band center band sets up at the moving average chosen for the indicator.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Breakaway gap A classic gap, popularized in Technical Analysis of Stock Trends , that signals the start of a new trend after a prolonged basing period.
texts.text: Breakaway gap A classic gap, popularized in Technical Analysis of Stock Trends , that signals the start of a new trend after a prolonged basing period.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Bucket shops Early 20th century stock gambling parlors that catered to short-term speculation. Fictional trader Jesse Livermore discusses his experiences in them in the classic Reminiscences of a Stock Operator .
texts.text: Bucket shops Early 20th century stock gambling parlors that catered to short-term speculation. Fictional trader Jesse Livermore discusses his experiences in them in the classic Reminiscences of a Stock Operator .

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Charting landscape A 3D view that evaluates complex price action through multiple layers of information on a single price chart.
texts.text: Charting landscape A 3D view that evaluates complex price action through multiple layers of information on a single price chart.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Coiled spring A trading strategy that executes a position at the interface between a rangebound market and a trending market.
texts.text: Coiled spring A trading strategy that executes a position at the interface between a rangebound market and a trending market.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Continuation gap A classic gap, popularized in Technical Analysis of Stock Trends , that signals the dynamic midpoint of an ongoing trend.
texts.text: Continuation gap A classic gap, popularized in Technical Analysis of Stock Trends , that signals the dynamic midpoint of an ongoing trend.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Convergence-divergence (C-D) The tendency of two or more charting landscape features to confirm or refute an expected price outcome.
texts.text: Convergence-divergence (C-D) The tendency of two or more charting landscape features to confirm or refute an expected price outcome.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Clear air (CA) Pockets of thin participation and ownership that often lead to wide range price bars.
texts.text: Clear air (CA) Pockets of thin participation and ownership that often lead to wide range price bars.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Climbing the ladder Bollinger Band pattern that indicates a strong and sustained rally.
texts.text: Climbing the ladder Bollinger Band pattern that indicates a strong and sustained rally.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Cross-verification (CV) The convergence of unrelated directional information at a single price level.
texts.text: Cross-verification (CV) The convergence of unrelated directional information at a single price level.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Cross-verification × 4 (CV × 4) A high-probability trade in which a single price and time emerges from analysis through at least four unrelated methods.
texts.text: Cross-verification × 4 (CV × 4) A high-probability trade in which a single price and time emerges from analysis through at least four unrelated methods.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Cup and handle (C&H) A popular pattern that triggers a breakout through a triple top. The formation draws a long and deep base after an intermediate high. The market rallies into a double top failure that creates the ''cup.' It pulls back in a small rounded correction that forms the 'handle' and then surges to a new high.
texts.text: Cup and handle (C&H) A popular pattern that triggers a breakout through a triple top. The formation draws a long and deep base after an intermediate high. The market rallies into a double top failure that creates the ''cup.' It pulls back in a small rounded correction that forms the 'handle' and then surges to a new high.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Cup and two handles (C&2H) A cup and handle variation that draws two congestion zones on the right side of the pattern before price ejects into a strong breakout.
texts.text: Cup and two handles (C&2H) A cup and handle variation that draws two congestion zones on the right side of the pattern before price ejects into a strong breakout.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Dark cloud cover A two-bar candlestick reversal pattern. The first bar draws a tall rally candle. The next candle gaps up but closes well within the range of the prior bar.
texts.text: Dark cloud cover A two-bar candlestick reversal pattern. The first bar draws a tall rally candle. The next candle gaps up but closes well within the range of the prior bar.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Descending triangle A common reversal pattern that forms from a descending upper trendline and a horizontal bottom support line.
texts.text: Descending triangle A common reversal pattern that forms from a descending upper trendline and a horizontal bottom support line.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Dip trip A trading strategy that buys pullbacks in an active bull market.
texts.text: Dip trip A trading strategy that buys pullbacks in an active bull market.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Doji A one-bar candlestick reversal pattern in which the open and close are the same (or almost the same) price and the high-low range is above average for that market.
texts.text: Doji A one-bar candlestick reversal pattern in which the open and close are the same (or almost the same) price and the high-low range is above average for that market.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Double bottom (DB) A common reversal pattern in which price prints a new low, reverses into a rally, and returns once to test the low before moving higher.
texts.text: Double bottom (DB) A common reversal pattern in which price prints a new low, reverses into a rally, and returns once to test the low before moving higher.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Double top (DT) A common reversal pattern in which price prints a new high, reverses into a selloff, and returns once to test the high before moving lower.
texts.text: Double top (DT) A common reversal pattern in which price prints a new high, reverses into a selloff, and returns once to test the high before moving lower.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Dow Theory Observations on the nature of trend by Charles Dow in the early 20th century. It also notes that broad market trends verify when the three major market averages all move to a new high or low.
texts.text: Dow Theory Observations on the nature of trend by Charles Dow in the early 20th century. It also notes that broad market trends verify when the three major market averages all move to a new high or low.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Electronic communications networks (ECNs) Computer stock exchanges that rapidly match, fill, and report customer limit orders.
texts.text: Electronic communications networks (ECNs) Computer stock exchanges that rapidly match, fill, and report customer limit orders.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Elliott Wave Theory (EWT) A pattern-recognition technique published by Ralph Nelson Elliott in 1939 that believes all markets move in five distinct waves when traveling in the direction of a primary trend and three distinct waves when traveling in a correction against a primary trend.
texts.text: Elliott Wave Theory (EWT) A pattern-recognition technique published by Ralph Nelson Elliott in 1939 that believes all markets move in five distinct waves when traveling in the direction of a primary trend and three distinct waves when traveling in a correction against a primary trend.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Empty zone (EZ) The interface between the end of a quiet rangebound market and the start of a new dynamic trending market.
texts.text: Empty zone (EZ) The interface between the end of a quiet rangebound market and the start of a new dynamic trending market.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Execution target (ET) The predetermined point in price, time, and risk that a trade entry should be considered.
texts.text: Execution target (ET) The predetermined point in price, time, and risk that a trade entry should be considered.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Execution zone (EZ) The time and price surrounding an execution target that requires undivided attention in order to decide if an trade entry is appropriate.
texts.text: Execution zone (EZ) The time and price surrounding an execution target that requires undivided attention in order to decide if an trade entry is appropriate.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Exhaustion gap A classic gap, popularized in Technical Analysis of Stock Trends , that signals the end of an active trend with one last burst of enthusiasm or fear.
texts.text: Exhaustion gap A classic gap, popularized in Technical Analysis of Stock Trends , that signals the end of an active trend with one last burst of enthusiasm or fear.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Fade A swing strategy that sells at resistance and buys at support.
texts.text: Fade A swing strategy that sells at resistance and buys at support.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Failure target The projected price that a losing trade will be terminated. The price at which a trade will be proven wrong.
texts.text: Failure target The projected price that a losing trade will be terminated. The price at which a trade will be proven wrong.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Farley's Accumulation-Distribution Accelerator (ADA) A technical indicator that measures the trend of accumulation-distribution.
texts.text: Farley's Accumulation-Distribution Accelerator (ADA) A technical indicator that measures the trend of accumulation-distribution.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Fibonacci (Fibs) The mathematical tendency of trends to find support at the 38%, 50%, or 62% retracement of the last dynamic move.
texts.text: Fibonacci (Fibs) The mathematical tendency of trends to find support at the 38%, 50%, or 62% retracement of the last dynamic move.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Finger finder A trading strategy that initiates a variety of tactics based upon one-bar candlestick reversals.
texts.text: Finger finder A trading strategy that initiates a variety of tactics based upon one-bar candlestick reversals.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: First rise/first failure (FR/FF) The first 100% retracement of the last dynamic price move after an extended trending market.
texts.text: First rise/first failure (FR/FF) The first 100% retracement of the last dynamic price move after an extended trending market.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 5-8-13 Intraday Bollinger Bands and moving average settings that align with short-term Fibonacci cycles. Set the Bollinger Bands to 13-bar and two standard deviations. Set the moving averages to 5-bar and 8-bar SMAs.
texts.text: 5-8-13 Intraday Bollinger Bands and moving average settings that align with short-term Fibonacci cycles. Set the Bollinger Bands to 13-bar and two standard deviations. Set the moving averages to 5-bar and 8-bar SMAs.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Five-wave decline A classic selloff pattern that exhibits three sharp downtrends and two weak bear rallies.
texts.text: Five-wave decline A classic selloff pattern that exhibits three sharp downtrends and two weak bear rallies.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Flags Small continuation pattern that prints against the direction of the primary trend.
texts.text: Flags Small continuation pattern that prints against the direction of the primary trend.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Foot in floor Bollinger Band pattern that indicates short-term support and reversal.
texts.text: Foot in floor Bollinger Band pattern that indicates short-term support and reversal.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Fractals Small-scale predictive patterns that repeat themselves at larger and larger intervals on the price chart.
texts.text: Fractals Small-scale predictive patterns that repeat themselves at larger and larger intervals on the price chart.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Gap echo A gap that breaks through the same level as a recent one in the opposite direction.
texts.text: Gap echo A gap that breaks through the same level as a recent one in the opposite direction.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Hammer A one-bar candlestick reversal pattern in which the open-close range is much smaller than the high-low range that prints well above average for that market.  The real body must sit at one extreme of the high-low range.
texts.text: Hammer A one-bar candlestick reversal pattern in which the open-close range is much smaller than the high-low range that prints well above average for that market.  The real body must sit at one extreme of the high-low range.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Harami A one-bar candlestick reversal pattern in which the open-close range is much smaller than the high-low range and sits within the real body of a tall prior bar.
texts.text: Harami A one-bar candlestick reversal pattern in which the open-close range is much smaller than the high-low range and sits within the real body of a tall prior bar.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Hard right edge The location where the next bar will print on the price chart. This also points to the spot where the swing trader must predict the future.
texts.text: Hard right edge The location where the next bar will print on the price chart. This also points to the spot where the swing trader must predict the future.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Head and shoulders This classic reversal pattern forms from an extended high that sits between two lower highs. Three relative lows beneath the three highs connect at a trendline known as the neckline. Popular opinion expects a major selloff when the neckline breaks.
texts.text: Head and shoulders This classic reversal pattern forms from an extended high that sits between two lower highs. Three relative lows beneath the three highs connect at a trendline known as the neckline. Popular opinion expects a major selloff when the neckline breaks.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Head in ceiling Bollinger Band pattern that indicates short-term resistance and reversal.
texts.text: Head in ceiling Bollinger Band pattern that indicates short-term resistance and reversal.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Historical volatility The range of price movement over an extended period of time as compared to current activity.
texts.text: Historical volatility The range of price movement over an extended period of time as compared to current activity.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Hole-in-the-wall A sharp down gap that immediately follows a major rally.
texts.text: Hole-in-the-wall A sharp down gap that immediately follows a major rally.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Inside day A price bar that prints a lower high and higher low than the bar that precedes it.
texts.text: Inside day A price bar that prints a lower high and higher low than the bar that precedes it.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Inverse head and shoulders This classic reversal pattern forms from an extended low that sits between two higher lows. Three relative highs above the three lows connect at a trendline known as the neckline.  Popular opinion expects a major rally when the neckline breaks.
texts.text: Inverse head and shoulders This classic reversal pattern forms from an extended low that sits between two higher lows. Three relative highs above the three lows connect at a trendline known as the neckline.  Popular opinion expects a major rally when the neckline breaks.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: January Effect The tendency of stocks to recover in January after end-of-year, tax-related selling has completed.
texts.text: January Effect The tendency of stocks to recover in January after end-of-year, tax-related selling has completed.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Mesa top A double top reversal pattern that declines at the same angle as the initial rally.
texts.text: Mesa top A double top reversal pattern that declines at the same angle as the initial rally.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Moving Average Convergence-Divergence (MACD) A trend-following indicator that tracks two exponentially smoothed moving averages above and below a zero line.
texts.text: Moving Average Convergence-Divergence (MACD) A trend-following indicator that tracks two exponentially smoothed moving averages above and below a zero line.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Moving average crossover The point where a moving average intersects with another moving average or with price.
texts.text: Moving average crossover The point where a moving average intersects with another moving average or with price.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Moving average ribbons (MARs) Wide bands of mathematically related and color-coded moving averages.
texts.text: Moving average ribbons (MARs) Wide bands of mathematically related and color-coded moving averages.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Narrow-range bar (NR) A price bar with a smaller high-low range as compared to the prior bar's high-low range.
texts.text: Narrow-range bar (NR) A price bar with a smaller high-low range as compared to the prior bar's high-low range.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Narrowest range of the last seven bars (NR7) A low-volatility time-price convergence that often precedes a major price expansion. A price bar with a smaller high-low range as compared to the prior six bars' high-low ranges.
texts.text: Narrowest range of the last seven bars (NR7) A low-volatility time-price convergence that often precedes a major price expansion. A price bar with a smaller high-low range as compared to the prior six bars' high-low ranges.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: NR7-2 The second NR7 in a row. A low-volatility time-price convergence that often precedes a major price expansion.
texts.text: NR7-2 The second NR7 in a row. A low-volatility time-price convergence that often precedes a major price expansion.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Neckline A trendline drawn under the support of a head and shoulders pattern or over the resistance of an inverse head and shoulders pattern.
texts.text: Neckline A trendline drawn under the support of a head and shoulders pattern or over the resistance of an inverse head and shoulders pattern.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Negative feedback Directionless price action in which bars move back and forth between welldefined boundaries.
texts.text: Negative feedback Directionless price action in which bars move back and forth between welldefined boundaries.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Noise Price and volume fluctuations that confuse interpretation of market direction.
texts.text: Noise Price and volume fluctuations that confuse interpretation of market direction.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: On Balance Volume (OBV) A volume indicator that measures the progress of accumulationdistribution.
texts.text: On Balance Volume (OBV) A volume indicator that measures the progress of accumulationdistribution.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Oscillator A subset of technical indicators that accurately measures flat market conditions by assigning overbought and oversold price levels.
texts.text: Oscillator A subset of technical indicators that accurately measures flat market conditions by assigning overbought and oversold price levels.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Overbought The evolution of price action to a state in which it runs out of buying pressure.
texts.text: Overbought The evolution of price action to a state in which it runs out of buying pressure.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Oversold The evolution of price action to a state in which it runs out of selling pressure.
texts.text: Oversold The evolution of price action to a state in which it runs out of selling pressure.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Pattern analysis Price prediction through interpretation of the crowd behavior seen in repeating chart formations.
texts.text: Pattern analysis Price prediction through interpretation of the crowd behavior seen in repeating chart formations.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Pattern Cycles The tendency of markets to repeat identical price formations through different stages of development in all time frames. The master market blue-print that generates all chart patterns.
texts.text: Pattern Cycles The tendency of markets to repeat identical price formations through different stages of development in all time frames. The master market blue-print that generates all chart patterns.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Pennant Small continuation pattern that prints against the direction of the primary trend.
texts.text: Pennant Small continuation pattern that prints against the direction of the primary trend.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: %WIN A performance measurement that shows the total winners divided by the total number of trades.
texts.text: %WIN A performance measurement that shows the total winners divided by the total number of trades.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Positive feedback Directional price action in which bars gather momentum and move from one level to the next.
texts.text: Positive feedback Directional price action in which bars gather momentum and move from one level to the next.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Power spike A trading strategy that seeks high-volume events and executes positions to capitalize on their special characteristics.
texts.text: Power spike A trading strategy that seeks high-volume events and executes positions to capitalize on their special characteristics.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Profit target The projected price that a successful trade will be terminated. The price at which a trade faces first resistance.
texts.text: Profit target The projected price that a successful trade will be terminated. The price at which a trade faces first resistance.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Random Walk Classic theory that chaos drives all market activity and that price movement cannot be predicted.
texts.text: Random Walk Classic theory that chaos drives all market activity and that price movement cannot be predicted.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Rectangle Small continuation pattern that prints sideways to the primary trend.
texts.text: Rectangle Small continuation pattern that prints sideways to the primary trend.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Relative Strength Index A technical indicator that measures a stock's ability to close up rather than down for a specific period of time. An oscillator invented by J. Welles Wilder that measures overbought, oversold, and divergent market situations.
texts.text: Relative Strength Index A technical indicator that measures a stock's ability to close up rather than down for a specific period of time. An oscillator invented by J. Welles Wilder that measures overbought, oversold, and divergent market situations.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Ribbon crosspoint A horizontal support and resistance zone created by a moving average crossover.
texts.text: Ribbon crosspoint A horizontal support and resistance zone created by a moving average crossover.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Rising wedge Reversal pattern that slowly rises in an uptrend until price suddenly ejects into a selloff.
texts.text: Rising wedge Reversal pattern that slowly rises in an uptrend until price suddenly ejects into a selloff.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Seasonality The predictable appearance of certain market characteristics that reflect specific and repeating calendar events.
texts.text: Seasonality The predictable appearance of certain market characteristics that reflect specific and repeating calendar events.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Setup A sequence of bars, patterns, or other charting landscape features that predict the direction and timing of future price movement.
texts.text: Setup A sequence of bars, patterns, or other charting landscape features that predict the direction and timing of future price movement.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Shooting star A one-to-three-bar candlestick reversal pattern with a small real body and tall shadow that pushes into an intermediate high before a sudden change in direction.
texts.text: Shooting star A one-to-three-bar candlestick reversal pattern with a small real body and tall shadow that pushes into an intermediate high before a sudden change in direction.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Signpost Point on the charting landscape that identifies an imminent trading opportunity.
texts.text: Signpost Point on the charting landscape that identifies an imminent trading opportunity.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Silent alarm A rare high-volume signal that prints a narrow range bar and flags an impending breakout.
texts.text: Silent alarm A rare high-volume signal that prints a narrow range bar and flags an impending breakout.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Slippage The difference between expected transaction costs and actual transaction costs.
texts.text: Slippage The difference between expected transaction costs and actual transaction costs.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Slippery slope Bollinger Band pattern that indicates a sustained decline.
texts.text: Slippery slope Bollinger Band pattern that indicates a sustained decline.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Standard deviation (std dev) The positive square root of the expected value of the square of the difference between a random variable and its mean.
texts.text: Standard deviation (std dev) The positive square root of the expected value of the square of the difference between a random variable and its mean.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Stochastics An overbought-oversold oscillator that compares the current bar to a preset selection of high and low prices. The indicator plots the results on a graph between 0 and 100.
texts.text: Stochastics An overbought-oversold oscillator that compares the current bar to a preset selection of high and low prices. The indicator plots the results on a graph between 0 and 100.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Support-resistance (S/R) Horizontal and nonhorizontal barriers that current price should not pass without the application of sufficient directional force.
texts.text: Support-resistance (S/R) Horizontal and nonhorizontal barriers that current price should not pass without the application of sufficient directional force.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Swing trading A complex execution strategy that relies on identification of market opportunity through the charting landscape.
texts.text: Swing trading A complex execution strategy that relies on identification of market opportunity through the charting landscape.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Symmetrical triangle A common pattern formed from descending and rising trendlines. The formation has an equal bias of breaking out in either direction.
texts.text: Symmetrical triangle A common pattern formed from descending and rising trendlines. The formation has an equal bias of breaking out in either direction.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Technical analysis Market prediction that studies crowd behavior through evolving price and volume activity.
texts.text: Technical analysis Market prediction that studies crowd behavior through evolving price and volume activity.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 3rd of a 3rd The middle wave and most dynamic price movement within a complete Elliott fivewave rally or decline.
texts.text: 3rd of a 3rd The middle wave and most dynamic price movement within a complete Elliott fivewave rally or decline.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 3rd watch A trading strategy that executes a long position on a triple top breakout.
texts.text: 3rd watch A trading strategy that executes a long position on a triple top breakout.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trend mirrors (TM) Past chart activity that influences the direction and development of current trend and range.
texts.text: Trend mirrors (TM) Past chart activity that influences the direction and development of current trend and range.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trend relativity error A common mistake committed when a trader prepares an analysis in one time frame but executes in another.
texts.text: Trend relativity error A common mistake committed when a trader prepares an analysis in one time frame but executes in another.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trendlet Small pocket of chart activity that appears and disappears over time.
texts.text: Trendlet Small pocket of chart activity that appears and disappears over time.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Trendline A line that connects a series of highs or lows. The trendline can represent support in an uptrend or resistance in a downtrend. Horizontal trendlines mark support-resistance and rangebound conditions.
texts.text: Trendline A line that connects a series of highs or lows. The trendline can represent support in an uptrend or resistance in a downtrend. Horizontal trendlines mark support-resistance and rangebound conditions.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Triangles A related set of common three-sided congestion patterns. Wave Sustained price movement in one direction marked by clear high and low reversal boundaries. Whipsaw Erratic price behavior that triggers false signals and incurs trading losses.
texts.text: Triangles A related set of common three-sided congestion patterns. Wave Sustained price movement in one direction marked by clear high and low reversal boundaries. Whipsaw Erratic price behavior that triggers false signals and incurs trading losses.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Window dressing Institutional buying or selling near the end of a quarter that makes reported results appear better than actual results.
texts.text: Window dressing Institutional buying or selling near the end of a quarter that makes reported results appear better than actual results.
